notice: This check-in is a supportive check to help place members safely and thoughtfully. It is not a diagnostic tool or mental health evaluation.

items.prompt: How comfortable do you feel meeting new people in a small group setting?
Over the past two weeks, how often have you felt able to engage in routine social activities?
Do you currently feel in a safe space to participate in weekly in-person group conversations?

scoring.note: Scoring thresholds marked for TODO_CLINICAL_REVIEW. Raw answers must be discarded immediately.

helpline_resources.message: Thanks for being honest. Before we place you in a group, one of our team would like to have a quick, friendly call. If you'd like to talk to someone right now, Tele-MANAS (14416) offers free support; in an emergency call 112.
